openQuestions: rooms-individual/04-section: the vision review tagged it video/media and the still looks like a video frame (pencil mid-stroke). Is this slot a background video? If yes, swap the img for the backgroundVideo module markup (div.bg-video[data-bg-video] with a poster img) inside the same figure; the figure class family does not change.

happenings-indiv/03-section and blog-indiv/03-section hold a #D9D9D9 placeholder rectangle, not an empty section. Which image fills it? C01 proposes no image field for cms-happenings-blog-indiv, so either add one (bind the image prop to it) or supply a static image.
rooms-individual is the rooms-collection template page. Should the base image bind to a per-room CMS image field, or stay the same static image on every room?
No mobile design exists. The plan keeps the desktop aspect ratios at every breakpoint (base is about 326 by 196 px at 390 wide). Confirm, or give a taller mobile ratio (for example 4 / 3).

Vertical spacing: Figma gaps around the section are 130/40 px (rooms-individual), 163/40 px (arts) and 150/202 px (happenings-indiv). The plan gives the section padding-section-small (3rem) and leaves the rest to the neighbours' padding; K01 should confirm once neighbouring plans fix their own padding.
deviations: Brief variant `is-cream + is-no-image + is-regular` replaced by one modifier `is-small` on image-inset-single_figure. Reason: every instance, base included, sits on cream #F4EFDF, so is-cream changes nothing; the variant does have an image (a placeholder), so is-no-image is wrong; the shorter height follows from the narrower figure and its own aspect ratio, so is-regular is not needed.
Brief describes the base as a full-bleed background image. The crops show an inset image inside the container on a cream section, so the image is an img in a figure, not a section background.

The modifier sits on the figure, not on section_image-inset-single, because Webflow combo classes cannot style descendants. In the Webflow component, expose it as a component variant (base, small) that swaps the figure's combo class.
No image-inset-single_component wrapper and no header or footer wrappers: the component has no text or CTA, and the figure is the only child of the container.
Figma image width is 1253 px in a 1600 px frame (x 178); container-large gives 1280 px (x 160). The 27 px difference is accepted to stay on the shared container.
Section background is set explicitly to color-neutral-100 (#F4EFDF per figma/tokens.json; the Relume default for that variable is #F5F5F5 until Q001 syncs it).
